title: द्व्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Vishnu sends the gods to Agastya. Lomasha tells how Agastya once stopped the Vindhya mountain, which was growing to block the sun, by asking it to bow low until he returned from the south, and never returned; now the gods ask Agastya to drink the ocean.
summary.kn: ವಿಷ್ಣು ದೇವತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಗಸ್ತ್ಯರಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೂರ್ಯನನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲು ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ವಿಂಧ್ಯಪರ್ವತವನ್ನು, ತಾನು ದಕ್ಷಿಣದಿಂದ ಮರಳುವವರೆಗೆ ತಗ್ಗಿರು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಅಗಸ್ತ್ಯರು ತಡೆದು ಎಂದೂ ಮರಳಲಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಲೋಮಶರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಈಗ ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಸಮುದ್ರ ಕುಡಿಯೆಂದು ಅಗಸ್ತ್ಯರನ್ನು ಬೇಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: विष्णु देवताओं को अगस्त्य के पास भेजते हैं। लोमश बताते हैं कि अगस्त्य ने एक बार सूर्य को रोकने के लिए बढ़ते विन्ध्य पर्वत को यह कहकर रोका था कि उनके दक्षिण से लौटने तक झुका रहे, और वे कभी नहीं लौटे; अब देवता अगस्त्य से समुद्र पीने की प्रार्थना करते हैं।
summary.te: విష్ణువు దేవతలను అగస్త్యుని వద్దకు పంపుతాడు. సూర్యుని అడ్డుకోవడానికి పెరుగుతున్న వింధ్యపర్వతాన్ని, తాను దక్షిణం నుండి తిరిగివచ్చే వరకు వంగి ఉండమని చెప్పి అగస్త్యుడు ఆపి ఎన్నడూ తిరిగి రాలేదని లోమశుడు చెబుతాడు; ఇప్పుడు దేవతలు సముద్రాన్ని తాగమని అగస్త్యుని కోరతారు.
summary.ta: விஷ்ணு தேவர்களை அகஸ்த்யரிடம் அனுப்புகிறார். சூரியனைத் தடுக்க வளர்ந்துகொண்டிருந்த விந்திய மலையைத் தாம் தெற்கிலிருந்து திரும்பும் வரை தாழ்ந்திருக்குமாறு சொல்லி அகஸ்த்யர் நிறுத்தி, திரும்பவேயில்லை என்று லோமஶர் சொல்கிறார்; இப்போது தேவர்கள் கடலைக் குடிக்குமாறு அகஸ்த்யரை வேண்டுகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: വിഷ്ണു ദേവന്മാരെ അഗസ്ത്യന്റെ അടുത്തേക്ക് അയക്കുന്നു. സൂര്യനെ മറയ്ക്കാൻ വളർന്നുവന്ന വിന്ധ്യപർവതത്തെ, താൻ തെക്കുനിന്ന് മടങ്ങും വരെ തല താഴ്ത്തിനിൽക്കാൻ പറഞ്ഞ് അഗസ്ത്യൻ തടഞ്ഞതും അദ്ദേഹം മടങ്ങിവരാത്തതും ലോമശൻ പറയുന്നു; ഇപ്പോൾ സമുദ്രം കുടിക്കാൻ ദേവന്മാർ അഗസ്ത്യനോട് അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.102; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
किमर्थं सहसा विन्ध्यः प्रवृद्धः क्रोधमूर्छितः ।
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण महामुने ॥

meaning.en: Great sage, why did the Vindhya suddenly swell, overcome with anger? I wish to hear this in detail.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
अद्रिराजं महाशैलं मरुं कनकपर्वतम् ।
उदयास्तमये भानुः प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: The sun used to circle in a sunwise round, at rising and setting, the king of mountains, the great golden mountain Meru.

verses.text:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथा विन्ध्यः शैलः सूर्यमथाब्रवीत् ।
यथा हि मेरुर्भवता नित्यशः परिगम्यते ।
प्रदक्षिणं च क्रियते मामेवं कुरु भास्कर ॥

meaning.en: Seeing this, the Vindhya mountain said to the sun, "As you always go round Meru and make your round about it, sun, do the same for me."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्ततः सूर्यः शैलेन्द्रं प्रत्यभाषत ।
नाहमात्मेच्छया शैल करोम्येनं प्रदक्षिणम् ।
एष मार्गः प्रदिष्टो मे येनेदं निर्मितं जगत् ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, the sun replied to the lord of mountains, "Mountain, I do not circle him of my own wish. This is the path set for me by him who made the world."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्ततः क्रोधात्प्रवृद्धः सहसाचलः ।
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्मार्गं रोद्धुमिच्छन्परंतप ॥

meaning.en: Told this, the mountain, scorcher of foes, suddenly grew in anger, wishing to block the path of the sun and moon.

verses.text:
ततो देवाः सहिताः सर्व एव
सेन्द्राः समागम्य महाद्रिराजम् ।
निवारयामासुरुपायतस्तं
न च स्म तेषां वचनं चकार ॥

meaning.en: Then all the gods together with Indra came to the great king of mountains and tried by gentle means to hold him back, but he did not heed their words.

verses.text:
अथाभिजग्मुर्मुनिमाश्रमस्थं
तपस्विनं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठम् ।
अगस्त्यमत्यद्भुतवीर्यदीप्तं
तं चार्थमूचुः सहिताः सुरास्ते ॥

meaning.en: Then they went to the sage in his hermitage, an ascetic, the best of those who uphold dharma, Agastya, blazing with astonishing power, and all the gods together told him the matter.

verses.text: देवा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The gods said:

verses.text:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्मार्गं नक्षत्राणां गतिं तथा ।
शैलराजो वृणोत्येष विन्ध्यः क्रोधवशानुगः ॥

meaning.en: The king of mountains, Vindhya, obeying his anger, is blocking the path of the sun and moon and the course of the stars.

verses.text:
तं निवारयितुं शक्तो नान्यः कश्चिद्द्विजोत्तम ।
ऋते त्वां हि महाभाग तस्मादेनं निवारय ॥

meaning.en: Best of brahmins, no one but you can stop him, great sage. So stop him.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं विप्रः सुराणां शैलमभ्यगात् ।
सोऽभिगम्याब्रवीद्विन्ध्यं सदारः समुपस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the gods' words the brahmin went to the mountain, and approaching Vindhya with his wife he said:

verses.text:
मार्गमिच्छाम्यहं दत्तं भवता पर्वतोत्तम ।
दक्षिणामभिगन्तास्मि दिशं कार्येण केनचित् ॥

meaning.en: "Best of mountains, I want you to give me a passage. For some purpose I am going to the southern quarter.

verses.text:
यावदागमनं मह्यं तावत्त्वं प्रतिपालय ।
निवृत्ते मयि शैलेन्द्र ततो वर्धस्व कामतः ॥

meaning.en: "Until I come back, wait for me. When I have returned, lord of mountains, then grow as you please."

verses.text:
एवं स समयं कृत्वा विन्ध्येनामित्रकर्शन ।
अद्यापि दक्षिणाद्देशाद्वारुणिर्न निवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Having made this agreement with the Vindhya, destroyer of foes, Varuna's son has never returned even now from the southern region.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथा विन्ध्यो न वर्धते ।
अगस्त्यस्य प्रभावेन यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: I have told you all about how the Vindhya does not grow, through Agastya's power, as you asked.

verses.text:
कालेयास्तु यथा राजन्सुरैः सर्वैर्निषूदिताः ।
अगस्त्याद्वरमासाद्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥

meaning.en: Now hear from me, king, how the Kaleyas were killed by all the gods after they received a boon from Agastya.

verses.text:
त्रिदशानां वचः श्रुत्वा मैत्रावरुणिरब्रवीत् ।
किमर्थमभियाताः स्थ वरं मत्तः किमिच्छथ ।
एवमुक्तास्ततस्तेन देवास्तं मुनिमब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the gods, the son of Mitra and Varuna said, "Why have you come? What boon do you want of me?" Thus addressed, the gods said to the sage:

verses.text:
एवं त्वयेच्छाम कृतं महर्षे
महार्णवं पीयमानं महात्मन् ।
ततो वधिष्याम सहानुबन्धा-
न्कालेयसंज्ञान्सुरविद्विषस्तान् ॥

meaning.en: "Great sage, we want you to drink the great ocean, great soul. Then we will kill the Kaleyas, the enemies of the gods, together with their followers."

verses.text:
त्रिदशानां वचः श्रुत्वा तथेति मुनिरब्रवीत् ।
करिष्ये भवतां कामं लोकानां च महत्सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the gods, the sage said, "So be it. I will fulfil your wish and bring great happiness to the worlds."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ततोऽगच्छत्समुद्रं सरितां पतिम् ।
ऋषिभिश्च तपःसिद्धैः सार्धं देवैश्च सुव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, that man of fine vows went to the sea, lord of rivers, with the sages perfected by austerity and with the gods.

verses.text:
मनुष्योरगगन्धर्वयक्षकिंपुरुषास्तथा ।
अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानं द्रष्टुकामास्तदद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Humans, serpents, gandharvas, yakshas and kimpurushas followed the great soul, wishing to see that marvel.

verses.text:
ततोऽभ्यगच्छन्सहिताः समुद्रं भीमनिस्वनम् ।
नृत्यन्तमिव चोर्मीभिर्वल्गन्तमिव वायुना ॥

meaning.en: Together they came to the sea with its fearsome roar, which seemed to dance with its waves and leap with the wind,

verses.text:
हसन्तमिव फेनौघैः स्खलन्तं कन्दरेषु च ।
नानाग्राहसमाकीर्णं नानाद्विजगणायुतम् ॥

meaning.en: to laugh with masses of foam and stumble in its hollows, filled with many sea monsters and many flocks of birds.

verses.text:
अगस्त्यसहिता देवाः सगन्धर्वमहोरगाः ।
ऋषयश्च महाभागाः समासेदुर्महोदधिम् ॥

meaning.en: The gods, with Agastya, with gandharvas and great serpents, and the fortunate sages, reached the great ocean.
